symptom: With configuration Default at HttpPortNumber 8085 / ServerPortNumber 8095, `run --local --configuration Default` listened on 8080/8090; only --app-port/--admin-port moved it.
file: cmd/mxcli/runports.go runPorts; cmd/mxcli/constants_resolve.go resolveConstantChain (constantChain.AppPort/AdminPort); cmd/mxcli/cmd_run.go. Test: cmd/mxcli/runports_2365_test.go
cause: The run took constants and JVM options from the chosen configuration (chooseConfiguration) but its ports only from the flags, whose 0 meant the docker package's 8080/8090 defaults.
insight: **Everything a run takes from a configuration should come from the one choice.** Constants and JVM args already rode on constantChain; the ports were the field left out. Measured on 11.12.6 after the fix: the configuration's 8085/8095 → app HTTP 200 on 8085, admin 200 on 8095, nothing on 8080; flags still override each port on its own.
